name: African Lion
description: The African lion is a large carnivorous feline that lives in prides. Known as the 'King of the Jungle', lions are apex predators with distinctive manes in males.
facts: A lion's roar can be heard from 5 miles away
Female lions do most of the hunting
Lions sleep up to 20 hours a day
A pride can have up to 30 lions

name: Bengal Tiger
description: The Bengal tiger is the most numerous tiger subspecies. They are solitary hunters with distinctive orange coats and black stripes.
facts: Each tiger has a unique stripe pattern
Can leap up to 10 meters horizontally
Have night vision 6 times better than humans

name: African Elephant
description: The African elephant is the largest land animal. They are highly intelligent with complex social structures and use their trunks for various tasks.
facts: Can consume up to 150 kg of food daily

name: Giant Panda
description: Giant pandas are black and white bears known for their love of bamboo. They spend most of their day eating and are symbols of conservation.
facts: Eat up to 38 kg of bamboo daily
Have an extra 'thumb' for gripping bamboo
Cubs are born pink and helpless

name: Blue Whale
description: The blue whale is the largest animal ever known to have lived on Earth. These marine mammals can weigh as much as 24 elephants.
facts: Tongue can weigh as much as an elephant
Can consume 4 tons of krill per day

name: Red Fox
description: The red fox is the largest true fox species. They are highly adaptable and can be found across the entire Northern Hemisphere.
facts: Can hear a mouse squeaking 100 feet away
Use Earth's magnetic field to hunt

name: Bald Eagle
description: The bald eagle is a bird of prey found in North America and the national bird of the United States. They are known for their distinctive white head.
facts: Can see fish from 2 miles away
Dive at speeds up to 160 km/h
Build the largest tree nests of any animal

name: Emperor Penguin
description: Emperor penguins are the tallest and heaviest of all penguin species. They endure the Antarctic winter to breed.
facts: Can dive up to 550 meters deep
Males incubate eggs for 64 days without eating
Can hold breath for over 20 minutes

name: Great White Shark
description: The great white shark is the largest predatory fish. These apex predators can detect a single drop of blood in 100 liters of water.
facts: Can swim at speeds of 56 km/h
Have been around for 400 million years

name: Green Sea Turtle
description: Green sea turtles are large marine reptiles named for the green color of their fat. They migrate long distances between feeding grounds and nesting beaches.
facts: Can hold breath for 4-7 hours while resting
Return to the same beach where they hatched

name: Komodo Dragon
description: The Komodo dragon is the largest living lizard. They have venomous bites and can take down prey much larger than themselves.
facts: Can eat up to 80% of their body weight
Can run up to 20 km/h in short bursts

name: Arctic Wolf
description: Arctic wolves are a subspecies of grey wolf adapted to survive in extreme cold. They have thick white coats and live in packs.
facts: Travel up to 18 km per day hunting

name: Cheetah
description: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, capable of running at speeds up to 120 km/h. They have distinctive black tear marks.
facts: Can accelerate from 0 to 96 km/h in 3 seconds
Hunt during the day unlike most big cats

name: Gorilla
description: Gorillas are the largest living primates. They are highly intelligent and share 98% of their DNA with humans.

name: Polar Bear
description: Polar bears are the largest land carnivores. They are adapted to life in the Arctic with thick fur and excellent swimming abilities.
facts: Fur is actually transparent, not white
Have black skin under white fur

name: Giraffe
description: Giraffes are the tallest mammals on Earth. Their long necks help them reach leaves high in trees that other animals cannot access.

name: Hippopotamus
description: Hippos are large semi-aquatic mammals. Despite their herbivorous diet, they are considered one of Africa's most dangerous animals.
facts: Teeth can grow up to 50 cm
Can run up to 30 km/h on land

name: Koala
description: Koalas are arboreal marsupials native to Australia. They sleep up to 22 hours a day and feed exclusively on eucalyptus leaves.
facts: Carry babies in pouches for 6 months

name: Red Kangaroo
description: The red kangaroo is the largest marsupial. They are famous for their powerful hind legs and ability to hop at high speeds.
facts: Can jump 3 meters high and 12 meters long
Hop at speeds up to 70 km/h
Can survive without water for months

name: Snow Leopard
description: Snow leopards are elusive big cats that live in harsh mountain environments. Their thick fur and large paws help them survive in snow.
facts: Tail helps with balance and warmth
Can't roar like other big cats

name: Bottlenose Dolphin
description: Bottlenose dolphins are highly intelligent marine mammals known for their playful behavior and complex social structures.
facts: Sleep with one brain hemisphere at a time

name: Orangutan
description: Orangutans are great apes known for their intelligence and distinctive red fur. They spend most of their time in trees.
facts: Can use tools to get food

name: Giant Squid
description: Giant squids are elusive deep-sea creatures and the largest invertebrates on Earth. They have the largest eyes in the animal kingdom.
facts: Eyes can be 30 cm in diameter
Can grow up to 13 meters long

name: Scarlet Macaw
habitat: Rainforests of Central and South America
description: Scarlet macaws are vibrant parrots known for their brilliant red, yellow, and blue plumage. They are highly social and intelligent birds.
facts: Can live up to 50 years in wild
Use beaks to crack hard nuts

name: Sloth
habitat: Rainforests of Central and South America
description: Sloths are slow-moving arboreal mammals known for spending most of their lives hanging upside down in trees.
facts: Move so slowly algae grows on their fur
